strength: Near-zero production cost (one standard deck plus a rule card) with a clear hook, and solid multiplayer numbers: seat gap 4.0 or less, runaway 36-60%, skill gap 72 points.
weakness: The advertised engine does not pay (Spades negative, Hearts-in-a-mixed-train wins, strategic barely beats greedy), solo is trivially won (98.6%), and the rules are heavier than the one-page brief with 11 ambiguities.
required_changes: Make the engine pay: test Spade discount 4 or Spade 2 points, or a 0-cost Club pull, one at a time; target Spade/Club win correlation >= 0 and strategic vs greedy >= 60% at 2p
Fix solo: raise the win line (about 31, re-measure), harsher Rival (2 cards per turn), longer solo; target strategic 45-55%, random under 15%, length 12-18 min
Close the stall loop with a Bench trim rule (remove leftmost Bench card when over 5 at end of turn); target zero turn-cap hits without bot patching
Resolve all 11 ambiguities and cut rules weight (consider dropping Apprentice, simplify Hearts bonus); target zero ambiguities and rules card on one side
Add decisions and interaction so the mid-game is not forced; target lead changes >= 2.5 and strategic vs greedy gap widened
Re-check 4-player length after engine changes (16.6 of 20 min); consider a 10-card target
revision_reason: Yes: failures have concrete testable fixes and multiplayer balance already passes, but limit to one revision and kill if the engine still does not outscore Heart play.
